automatic: The joining player’s running game is detected automatically.
incompatible-state: This state does not match the current games or player.
restart: Link play restarts the games from their in-game saves. Save inside your game before creating or joining a room.
saving: Save in the game first. Only your save syncs to RomM every 10 seconds. Save and quit waits for the upload to finish.
slot-hint: Choose consecutive slots from 1P for everyone in the room.
solo: Link disconnected. You can keep playing on your own.
supported: GB, GBC and GBA ROMs, including ZIP files containing one game, are supported.
